title: dodag.py: Hysteresis check considers non-admissible current parent
description: Lines 250-256: The hysteresis logic retrieves 'current' from self.parents directly, not from the admissible list. If the current preferred parent's path cost exceeds _lowest_rank + max_rank_increase (making it non-admissible), but the improvement over an admissible candidate is below threshold, the node incorrectly sticks with the non-admissible parent. Should check 'if current is not None and self._admissible(current) and current.neighbor_id != best.neighbor_id' before applying hysteresis.
close_reason: Same defect as worker6-exmu; fixed by adding _admissible(current) check to the hysteresis path per suggested predicate.
